_doc: PASTE AND LAYER STRUCTURE — the cross-language family for LAYER_STRUCTURE.md
R2 and R3 (ratified 2026-07-28).
R2: plain Paste FLATTENS into the ACTIVE layer. Where artwork lands must
not depend on an invisible property of where it came from.
R3: 'Paste, preserving layers' is a SEPARATE, EXPLICIT command — it appends
into a document layer of the same name and CREATES that layer when none
exists. Selected here by preserve_layers:true, never by a stored mode.
Before this family, op_apply had no paste verb in either port, so NO
fixture could reach ANY paste behaviour (LAYER_STRUCTURE.md §5) and both
rulings would have landed unwatched. Every case below drives the SAME
`paste_fragment_into` / `pasteFragmentInto` body the production paste path
calls — a verb that re-implemented the paste would be a decoy.
VALUE-IN-OP: `svg` carries the fragment markup literally, because the
clipboard is EXTERNAL state and a journaled paste that re-read it on replay
would not be a function of the journal. Every case is also checked by the
checkpoint_equivalence gate, which replays the op from its own params.
SVG px -> document pt is x3/4, so a fragment authored at x=16 lands at 12.
TWO THINGS THIS FAMILY PINS BUT DOES NOT RULE ON:
* ids are copied VERBATIM (paste_duplicates_the_source_id_verbatim) — a
pasted element can duplicate a live identity, which the cardinality law
says a 0->N paste should not do. Banked; the golden makes the day of the
ruling a visible byte change.
* a created layer takes the fragment's name VERBATIM and lands at the END
of the layer list. LAYER_STRUCTURE.md §6 open question 1. Conservative.
WHAT THIS FAMILY DOES NOT REACH, AND WHERE IT NOW LIVES. A LOCKED or HIDDEN
target layer is not driven here. That used to be a structural impossibility
-- the SVG codec dropped `locked` entirely, so no setup_svg could produce a
locked layer -- and jas:locked (LAYER_STRUCTURE.md 13.1) retired the
impossibility on 2026-07-28. The behaviour was RULED the same day (15) and
is gated by operations/paste_locked_layers.json, which seeds exactly such a
document. This family keeps the OPEN-target vectors; that one owns the
locked and hidden ones.
